title: Senior Product Designer (UX)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role As a Senior Product Designer, you will shape financial experiences that millions of people rely on every day. Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, where a confusing screen can cost someone a sale. Your job is to take complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into experiences that are simple and trustworthy. You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. You will work alongside a product manager and engineers, with support from researchers and content designers. What you'll do Lead design for a customer-facing product or an operational tool, from discovery through launch and the improvements that follow. Frame the problem with your product and engineering partners before designing the solution. Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused across products and platforms, and help evolve our design system. Design for accessibility and inclusion from the start, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device or level of digital literacy. Turn complex customer and business problems into simple journeys people can trust, crafted down to the smallest detail. Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact and keep improving it. Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions with clear reasoning, to designers, partners and leadership. Prototype early and test with real customers and real data, changing direction when the evidence says so. Raise the quality of design around you through critique and mentoring. What you need to succeed 7+ years of product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous projects end to end with minimal direction. A portfolio of shipped work that shows exceptional craft and clear thinking: the problem, your role, your decisions and what changed as a result. A record of framing the problem with product and engineering partners, not only designing the solution. Strong interaction and visual design skills across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail. Strong systems thinking: you design flexible templates and reusable patterns that adapt through configuration rather than one-off screens. A deep commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, with strong knowledge of the standards and shipped work that shows it. The ability to use both research and data to inform and evaluate design decisions. The confidence to advocate for your design decisions and hold your ground with senior stakeholders, in writing and in person, while staying open to better evidence. Experience giving useful critique and helping other designers grow. Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result. Nice to have Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome. What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership. Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations. Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough. Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description: About us Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role As a Senior UX researcher, you’ll be the voice of our users. You’ll play a critical role in shaping our product strategy by uncovering deep insights into the needs, behaviours, and aspirations of our users—especially within Nigeria. We’re on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, and your research will directly influence how we design products that are accessible, intuitive, and impactful. You’ll collaborate closely with our creators to ensure our solutions are grounded in real-world market realities. Key responsibilities Lead and execute end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research across the product lifecycle—from discovery to delivery. Use a range of methods including in-depth interviews, ethnographic studies, usability testing, surveys, and diary studies, with a focus on the Nigerian context. Synthesise complex data into actionable insights and frameworks (personas, journey maps, mental models) that drive empathy across the team. Stay ahead of fintech and consumer trends in Nigeria and comparable markets through continuous landscape analysis. Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business challenges into research questions. Act as the subject matter expert on Nigerian user needs, guiding our local expansion and regional growth across Africa. Structure and scale our research operations, including participant management and maintaining organised research repositories. Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels to drive action and product improvements. Qualifications 6+ years of experience in UX research or product research, ideally with digital B2C products. Deep experience researchng African markets, specifically Nigeria. Advanced expertise in qualitative and quantitative methodologies (co-creation, usability testing, literature reviews, etc.). Hands-on experience with tools like UserTesting, Maze, Typeform, or similar platforms. Proven track record of translating insights into tangible frameworks that guide business decisions. Preferred qualifications Experience building or engaging with active user communities in Nigeria. Background in fintech or banking environments. Experience scaling research practices in a fast-growth startup or scale-up. About you  You're driven by mastery and want to make the world a better place through your work. You love finding innovative ways to solve user problems. You speak the language of our users. You don't try to sound impressive with technical jargon; you stay relatable and friendly. You don't guess—you use data. You prefer not to speak if you're unsure of the facts.  You believe in Moniepoint’s mission and want to bring our audience along on the journey to financial happiness. What success looks like Product teams report a clearer understanding of user pain points, measured by feature adoption and user satisfaction. Research insights are consistently used to inform the product roadmap and business strategy. We establish a thriving research repository that is easily accessible to all product stakeholders. User recruitment becomes a seamless, automated process that allows for faster research cycles. You become the "go-to" person for understanding the Nigerian consumer’s financial journey. Please submit a resume highlighting your research experience and outlining research methodologies, processes, and the impact of your work on user experience and business outcomes. Optionally, you may also include a PDF portfolio with case studies that further illustrate your research approach and results. While a portfolio is not required, it can provide additional insight into your end-to-end research thinking and influence on product direction. Our hiring process Resume review: We look for strong experience that showcases your research process, methodologies, and impact. Technical interview with a senior researcher: Deep dive into your experience, approach, and alignment with our mission. Case study presentation: Present a research project to a panel, demonstrating your problem-solving, research craft, and strategic thinking. Executive interview: Discussion with senior leadership about your growth potential, influence, and ability to drive user and business success.

title: Staff Product Designer
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role  As a Staff Product Designer, you will take on our largest and most ambiguous design problems and set the long-term design direction for your product area. You will shape what we build as well as how it works: complex journeys, patterns other teams depend on, and the questions that decide what comes next.  Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, and your work will set the standard for how we do that.  You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. Your home team is where your work starts, not where it ends. The journeys you design and the patterns you create will cut across several teams, so you will work closely with designers, product managers and engineers on those teams to make sure the product holds together as one experience.  This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will lead through your work and your influence, partnering with design, product and engineering leaders, with support from researchers and content designers.  What you'll do  Own the design of our most complex work end to end, from discovery through launch and beyond.  Set the long-term design direction for your product area, thinking ahead to where the product is going so teams can plan and build towards it.  Work with product and engineering leaders to decide what we build and why, starting from the problem, not the solution.  Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused, and partner with our design system team to shape its direction.  Set the bar for accessibility and inclusion in your product area and help other teams reach it, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device, internet connection or level of digital literacy. Spot where features built by different teams overlap or conflict, and bring those teams to one design that works across the whole product.  Shape our biggest product bets by testing them with customers and data before we commit to building them.  Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact on customers and the business and keep improving it. Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions to senior leadership. Mentor designers and lead critique, raising the bar for design beyond your own work.  What you need to succeed  10+ years of product design experience, with recent hands-on work on large, ambiguous problems.  Exceptional interaction and visual design craft across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail.  A portfolio of shipped work that shows how you framed the problem, your role, the direction you set and what changed as a result, with the evidence to back it. Experience leading work that spans several teams or product areas, and bringing designers, product managers and engineers behind a shared direction. Experience setting design direction and influencing what gets built, working with senior product and engineering leaders.  Strong systems thinking, with patterns or templates that other designers have adopted. A track record of shipping accessible, inclusive products, and the ability to show the decisions you made for people with disabilities, low digital literacy or limited devices. Fluency in both research and data: you know which questions each can answer, and you use them to set direction and to judge whether shipped work succeeded. The confidence to defend your design decisions to senior leadership, and the judgment to change course on evidence.  Experience mentoring designers and leading design critique.  Curiosity about customers whose devices, connectivity and digital habits differ from your own.  Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result.  Nice to have  Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome.  What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership. Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations. Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough. Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

This role is responsible for both the hands-on delivery of complex systems work and the orchestration of team priorities, standards, and output quality. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works. This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets. Scope & Decision Horizon Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap. Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions. Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills. Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction. Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign. Infrastructure Management Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox). Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Cloud & Network Infrastructure Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity. Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points). Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services. Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies. AI Tools & Workflow Automation Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use. Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes. Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring. Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required. Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities. Telephony & Unified Communications Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning. Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration. Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites. Automation & Scripting Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment. Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios. Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently. Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management. Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance. Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes. User Endpoint & Technical Support Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management. Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations. Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption. Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination. Qualifications, Competencies & Skills Education & Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles. At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback. Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian). Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments. Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti). Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling. Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms. Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform. Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations. Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms. Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations. Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills. Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Leadership & Soft Skills Proven ability to lead a technical team: delegate effectively, deliver feedback, and develop others. Exceptional analytical and systematic troubleshooting approach; moves fast without compromising rigour. Strong documentation discipline — produces SOPs and runbooks clear enough for junior team members to execute. Candid communicator: surfaces risks early, documents dissent, and challenges direction constructively. Customer-obsessed: identifies and permanently resolves recurring pain points, not just individual tickets. title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos) Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner Job Purpose The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact. Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation. Key Responsibilities Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention. Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs. Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture. Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE. Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders. Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units. Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture.  Qualifications 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity. Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments. Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning. Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment. Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives. About You You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision. You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence. You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease. You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition. You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people. What Success Looks Like  You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions. Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes. You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness. Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes. You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback. Why join us Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities. Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.
